AttributeList.Text: This function block simplifies the usage of the AFx60 encoder on Siemens S7-1200 /S7-1500 PLCs. It's support you to exchange the acyclic service data between the PLC and the AFx60 via Profinet (according to PROFIdrive V4.1).

LineComment.Text:
============================================================================================= Name: FB_SICK_AFx60_PN Author: SICK AG Supported PLC: S7-1200/S7-1500
=============================================================================================== Description: This function block simplifies the usage of the AFx60 encoder on Siemens S7-1200 /S7-1500 PLCs. It's support you to exchange the acyclic service data between the PLC and the AFx60 via Profinet (according to PROFIdrive V4.1).
The function block uses the data structure ST_SICK_AFx60 to handle data. This data structure includes all service data parameters of the encoder which can exchanged via the PLC.
